purpose: Independently reviewed semantic gold assessment only; not a performance score.

reviewer.configuration_exposed: Codex agent; exact runtime model identifier, sampling configuration and seed are not exposed to this review.

rules: Explicit supported filters can execute despite irrelevant anecdotal uncertainty.
A mandatory authorship requirement whose intended author cannot be selected uniquely from supplied evidence requires clarification; do not guess a mapping from invented bibliographic names.
Different authors are not automatically mutually exclusive: books can have coauthors.
No catalogue evidence beyond the query/context is supplied. Do not assume an unavailable author-title mapping.
Revisions must preserve the original AMBIGUOUS testing objective and existing supported constraints, not change scope or authorization.

provenance.query_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of exact decoded query string encoded as UTF-8 without BOM; no normalization.
provenance.source_fingerprint_status: Copied from sole evidence input, not independently verified against any other file.

actual_access_and_call_restrictions.input_read_operations: Read once for review via Get-Content and once by this serialization/hash script; no other evidence file was opened.
tools_used: tools.exec_command (PowerShell read; Python standard-library hashing, JSON serialization and output write)
actual_access_and_call_restrictions.review_limitation: Judgments use only the supplied normative contract, query wording, actor and capability context. No catalogue evidence is inferred.

label_conventions.executable_kind: The supplied executable-kind enum is used only for executable queries. Non-executable candidates have null executable_kind, with executable_label false; no new enum member is invented.
label_conventions.verdict_vs_label: A candidate may be semantically AMBIGUOUS and still be rejected as a revision when it fails constraint preservation.

cases.verdict_scope: Acceptance of the candidate as a constraint-preserving revision for independently reviewed AMBIGUOUS gold; not parser performance.
cases.original_query: Find books my two-author note lists Novra Ashven and Talven Caldris beside titles "The Distant Garden" and "A River Causeway"; I cannot remember which author belongs to which title; titled "The Distant Garden"; rated at least 4 stars; digital format.
cases.candidate_query: Find books my two-author note lists Novra Ashven and Talven Caldris beside titles "The Distant Garden" and "A River Causeway"; I cannot remember which author belongs to which title; by the author my note pairs with the requested title; titled "The Distant Garden"; rated at least 4 stars; digital format.

original_interpretation.rationale: The requested title and all explicit supported filters are fixed. The remembered author-title association is anecdotal uncertainty; the original contains no mandatory by-clause requiring that association to be resolved.

candidate_interpretation.rationale: The new by-clause makes authorship by the author paired in the user note a mandatory condition. The requested title is fixed, but the note pairing is not supplied and the user explicitly cannot remember it. A title-only execution would omit that condition. No available evidence selects the required AUTHOR operand uniquely.

unresolved_operand.role: Mandatory author selected by the user-note pairing for the explicitly requested title.

ambiguity_alternatives: The note pairs the requested title with Novra Ashven; the mandatory AUTHOR operand is that author.
The note pairs the requested title with Talven Caldris; the mandatory AUTHOR operand is that author.
candidate_interpretation.execution_without_clarification_assessme: Not permitted under the supplied contract: the mandatory intended author cannot be selected uniquely. Searching only by the explicit title and the other filters, choosing either author, or silently treating both as OR would change the stated condition.
candidate_interpretation.coauthorship_assessment: The two names are not mutually exclusive authorship claims. Possible coauthorship neither creates a contradiction nor supplies the missing note pairing; it also does not justify an AND filter or make a guessed selection valid.
candidate_interpretation.incomplete_assessment: Two named alternatives and a fixed target title are supplied. The uncertainty is which supplied author fills the mandatory operand, rather than a missing target or a wholly unspecified author.

constraint_preservation.added_or_replaced_requirement: Mandatory authorship by whichever author the note pairs with the requested title.

necessity_and_minimality.reason: The original explicit query can execute despite irrelevant uncertainty in the note. The candidate ties that uncertainty to a mandatory AUTHOR condition, making it decision-relevant.
necessity_and_minimality.rationale: The single added clause supplies the missing dependency while retaining every original explicit filter and the supplied search context.

pattern_and_core_eligibility.reason: The unresolved author is necessary to execute the revised request; the ambiguity is substantive and all existing explicit constraints survive.

label_and_mask_amendments.application: Recommendation only; no dataset, code, policy, parser or mask files changed. Existing mask key schema was not supplied, so these semantic recommendations do not assert actual production key names.
label_and_mask_amendments.required_followup: None for semantic acceptance; labels and masks may be adopted through the parent evidence workflow.
